title: Burned-out campfire shows three hours of missing time
place_text: Smith Brook campsite, Eagle Lake, Maine

tellings.quote: And when we got back to shore, the fire was extinguished. So, that was a 3hour period of time. That is that missing time that everybody talks about.

plain: A man named Charlie Foltz told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a 1976 camping trip at the Smith Brook campsite on Eagle Lake in Maine. He says that when his group came back to shore after an encounter on the water, their campfire had burned out completely, which meant about three hours had passed that they could not account for, what people call "missing time". He mentions a researcher named Ray Fowler, and he tells it as evidence that something took those hours from them.
